instructions:
## Task

Visualize the original and generated EEG signal of Sub-03 using a line plot. Images and channels corresponding to each timepoint should be averaged before plotting. Save the line plot to "pred_results/eeg2eeg_vis_pred.png".

## Optional expert knowledge

Electroencephalogram (EEG) is the test that measures electrical activity in the brain.

## Input files

```text
|-- eeg2eeg_vis/
|---- fake_sub03.npy
|---- sub03.npy
```

## Submission and evaluator

Write a self-contained Python program that creates `pred_results/eeg2eeg_vis_pred.png`. Evaluation script: `eval_eeg2eeg_vis.py`.
